item.title: Aurora Christian’s Luke Baumann, only as a freshman, makes point at guard in playoff debut. ‘Nothing to lose.’
item.description: Luke Baumann scores 12 points to go with game-high 13 rebounds for Aurora Christian in 52-47 regional semifinal win.

item.title: Porter y Rollins encaminan a Bucks a victoria 118-116 ante Cavaliers disminuidos

item.title: EEUU e Irán mantendrán 3ra ronda de diálogo mientras Washington aumenta sus tropas en Oriente Medio

item.title: Wes Shelby feasts on big dunk as Lincoln-Way East rolls past Sandburg. His food of choice? ‘He loves Subway.’
item.description: Wes Shelby scores 10 points with a big dunk as Sandburg rolls to a 54-39 win over Sandburg in a regional semifinal.

item.title: Asking Eric: Friends booked annual trip without us
item.description: Dear Eric: They went to the shore and did all the things we usually do – posting all of it on social media – without us. I became more upset as I saw the photos. I feel this was a huge betrayal, enough that I do not care to see them for a while.

item.title: Kavon Ammons gets Rich Township past Thornwood, his former team. Still friends. Still bittersweet. ‘Love them.’
